title: Time-dependent shift from antagonism to synergism in mixture toxicity mediated by GFP-modified Caenorhabditis elegans.
authors: Li, Kai; Chen, Fu; Huang, Peng; Sun, Xiao; Li, Yongting; Li, Xiangwei; Xu, Ya-Qian; Liu, Shu-Shen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究GFP修饰线虫中混合物毒性随时间由拮抗转协同，仅涉及GFP蛋白与DAF-16的分子对接初步假设，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Environmental contaminant mixtures present complex toxicological challenges, especially in transgenic organisms where genetic modifications may alter toxicity mechanisms. This study addresses the uncharacterized influence of GFP fusion proteins on mixture interactions using Caenorhabditis elegans. We employed uniform design ray methodology to evaluate 6 compounds, including ionic liquids (ILs) such as 1-butylpyridinium chloride ([bpy]Cl) and 1-butylpyridinium bromide ([bpy]Br), pesticides (dichlorvos and glyphosate), and substituted phenols (4-chlorophenol and 4-nitrophenol), in transgenic DAF-16::GFP (DAF-16) versus wild-type N2 strains. Toxicity interactions were quantified using the improved combination index (CI(imp)) with 95% observation confidence intervals (OCIs) at 12 h and 24 h. Results showed that while ILs exhibited negligible lethality in N2, they induced marked toxicity in DAF-16. The transgenic strain demonstrated 10-100 times greater lethality to the mixtures compared to N2, with 95% OCIs confirming significant leftward shifts in concentration-response curves. A time-dependent interaction shift occurred: initial antagonism at 12 h (CI(imp) 1.315-7.340) transitioned to significant synergism exclusively in the DAF-16 strain at 24 h (CI(imp) <1; 95% OCIs excluded 1). Molecular docking provided a preliminary structural hypothesis, suggesting that GFP fusion might alter the accessibility of potential binding sites on DAF-16. These findings suggest that genetic modifications and exposure duration jointly modulate mixture toxicity, highlighting the need for cautious interpretation when using transgenic models in environmental risk assessment.
abstract_zh: 环境污染物混合物带来了复杂的毒理学挑战，尤其是在转基因生物中，基因修饰可能改变毒性机制。本研究针对未表征的GFP融合蛋白对混合物相互作用的影响，使用秀丽隐杆线虫（Caenorhabditis elegans）进行了探讨。我们采用均匀设计射线法评估了6种化合物，包括离子液体（ionic liquids, ILs），如1-丁基吡啶氯化物（[bpy]Cl）和1-丁基吡啶溴化物（[bpy]Br），农药（敌敌畏和草甘膦），以及取代酚类（4-氯苯酚和4-硝基苯酚），在转基因DAF-16::GFP（DAF-16）与野生型N2品系中进行了测试。毒性相互作用通过改进的组合指数（CI(imp)）在12小时和24小时时量化，并附有95%观测置信区间（OCIs）。结果显示，虽然ILs在N2中表现出可忽略的致死性，但它们在DAF-16中诱导了显著毒性。转基因品系对混合物的致死性比N2高10-100倍，95% OCIs确认了浓度-反应曲线显著左移。时间依赖性相互作用发生转变：在12小时时的初始拮抗作用（CI(imp) 1.315-7.340）在24小时时仅在DAF-16品系中转变为显著协同作用（CI(imp) <1；95% OCIs排除1）。分子对接提供了初步的结构假设，表明GFP融合可能改变DAF-16上潜在结合位点的可及性。这些发现表明，基因修饰和暴露时间共同调节混合物毒性，强调在使用转基因模型进行环境风险评估时需要谨慎解读。
